title: ArkUI test scenario SMOKE-FOCUS-001
user_prompt: Implement and validate the HarmonyOS ArkUI scenario represented by SMOKE-FOCUS-001. Preserve the APIs, routing, behavior, state, layout, and acceptance requirements defined by this test case. Output an implementation-ready development plan.
intent: Verify that SMOKE-FOCUS-001 routes to the expected ArkUI scene and preserves its implementation and validation requirements.

required_output_fields.route_reason: str reason for the selected route
required_output_fields.next_scene_refs: list[str] relative paths of the next scene documents
required_output_fields.next_scene_caps: list[str] secondary capability IDs defined by the referenced documents
required_output_fields.integration_edges: list[dict] integration edges with from, to, and edge fields
